page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a running head at the top and the page number at the top right. No margin notes and no notes below the text.

main_text.head: XXVI. EPISTOLA NAVARRENI REGIS AD CAROL. SUDERM. D. Suecię Heredem.
main_text.p: POSTEAQUAM regnum Gallicum per multos jam annos misere direptum, a bellis tandem civilibus conquievit, decreveramus, idque anno superiori, Navigationem in Angliam & Scotiam instituere atque inde in Belgium, Germaniam, Daniam & Sueciam, partim ut serenissimor plerosque rosque

page.notes: The first word of the paragraph is a large woodcut initial "P", joined to "Osteaquam" as printed ("Postea-quam"). The last line is partly illegible in the scan: "serenissimor" and "plerosque" are doubtful, and the line ends with "rosque" set low at the right, so the final word is read as "rosque" [?]. The word "serenissimorum" may be intended. The catchword is not printed. Scan shows some speckle and stains that are not text.
